item.title: Jimmy Lai, the Hong Kong media ‘troublemaker’ in Beijing’s crosshairs
item.description: A rags-to-riches tycoon, Hong Kong media boss Jimmy Lai is a self-styled “troublemaker” who has long been a thorn in Beijing’s side with his caustic tabloids and unapologetic support for democracy. The 78-year-old was found guilty on Monday on three charges in his national security trial widely condemned by Western nations as an attack on […]

item.title: Tai Po fire: Death toll climbs to 161 as forensic tests show remains belonged to 2 people
item.description: The death toll for the deadly Tai Po fire has climbed to 161, after forensic testing confirmed that one set of remains actually consisted of DNA from two people. item.title: Tai Po fire: First remains of Indonesian, Filipina domestic workers repatriated; 8 others expected this week
item.description: The remains of an Indonesian and a Filipina domestic worker killed in Hong Kong’s worst fire in decades have been repatriated, with the bodies of eight other Indonesians expected to be sent home later this week. item.title: 15 people arrested over 1 billion yen robbery; stolen money yet to be found
item.description: Hong Kong police have arrested 15 people over a 1 billion yen (HK$50 million) robbery in Sheung Wan last week, but the stolen cash has yet to be found. item.title: China to impose of up to 42.7% levies on EU dairy
item.description: China said on Monday would place temporary duties on “certain dairy products” imported from the European Union, marking the latest salvo in a trade spat that spans from food to electric vehicles. item.title: Chinese national wounded by Thai military shelling, Cambodia says
item.description: A Chinese national was wounded by Thai military shelling into Cambodia on Monday, Phnom Penh’s interior ministry said, as the Southeast Asian neighbours waged deadly border clashes. item.description: Hong Kong journalist Selina Cheng has denied that financial compensation is the primary reason for suing The Wall Street Journal (WSJ), saying she wants to hold her former employer accountable.
